The domain name.<props="china">You can call [DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the domain name.</props>

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

description.zh:
主机记录。

如果要解析@.exmaple.com，主机记录要填写”@”，而不是空。
description.en:
The host record.

To resolve @.example.com, set the host record to '@' instead of leaving it empty.

description.zh:
解析记录类型。如果不填写，则返回子域名对应的全部解析记录类型。

解析类型包括(不区分大小写)：**A、MX、CNAME、TXT、REDIRECT_URL、FORWORD_URL、NS、AAAA、SRV**。
description.en:
The type of the DNS record. If you do not specify this parameter, all types of DNS records for the subdomain are deleted.

Valid values (case-insensitive): A, MX, CNAME, TXT, REDIRECT\_URL, FORWARD\_URL, NS, AAAA, and **SRV**.
The IP address of the client.

title.zh: 删除主机记录对应的解析记录

descriptions.zh: 如果被删除的解析记录中存在锁定解析，则该锁定解析不会被删除。
descriptions.en: Locked DNS records will not be deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns delete-sub-domain-records --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.1 --domain-name example.com --rr www --type A --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DeleteSubDomainRecords --region cn-hangzhou --RR www --Type A --DomainName 'example.com' --UserClientIp '192.0.2.1' --Lang en
